title: Novel B,N-doped carbon quantum dot fluorescence quenching method for sensitive and green determination of lisinopril: mechanistic insights from quantum calculations and sustainable analytical approach
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,40006-40020
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05164A, Paper
Open Access

Taha Alqahtani, Ali Alqahtani, Adil Alshehri, Ahmed A. Almrasy
A B,N-doped carbon quantum dot fluorescence method was systematically developed and optimized for sensitive lisinopril determination. Comprehensive mechanistic investigation validated static quenching, with sustainable pharmaceutical analysis.
